SELECT c.office_id,
    m.id AS machinery_id,
    m.machinery_name,
    m.machinery_id_no,
    i.id AS item_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.unit_of_measurement,
    sum(c.quantity_consumed) AS total_consumed
   FROM ((gc_sub_ledger_consumption c
     JOIN gc_machinery m ON ((c.machinery_id = m.id)))
     JOIN gc_items i ON ((c.item_id = i.id)))
  GROUP BY c.office_id, m.id, m.machinery_name, m.machinery_id_no, i.id, i.item_name, i.unit_of_measurement;

SELECT i.office_id,
    i.id AS item_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.unit_of_measurement,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.transaction_type)::text = 'RECEIPT'::text) THEN t.quantity
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN ((t.transaction_type)::text = 'ISSUE'::text) THEN t.quantity
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric)) AS current_balance
   FROM (gc_items i
     LEFT JOIN gc_main_stock_transactions t ON ((i.id = t.item_id)))
  GROUP BY i.office_id, i.id, i.item_name, i.unit_of_measurement;

SELECT issue.office_id,
    issue.party AS consumed_by,
    i.id AS item_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.unit_of_measurement,
    (COALESCE(issue.total_issued, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(cons.total_consumed, (0)::numeric)) AS current_balance
   FROM ((( SELECT gc_main_stock_transactions.office_id,
            gc_main_stock_transactions.party,
            gc_main_stock_transactions.item_id,
            sum(gc_main_stock_transactions.quantity) AS total_issued
           FROM gc_main_stock_transactions
          WHERE ((gc_main_stock_transactions.transaction_type)::text = 'ISSUE'::text)
          GROUP BY gc_main_stock_transactions.office_id, gc_main_stock_transactions.party, gc_main_stock_transactions.item_id) issue
     JOIN gc_items i ON ((issue.item_id = i.id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gc_sub_ledger_consumption.office_id,
            gc_sub_ledger_consumption.consumed_by,
            gc_sub_ledger_consumption.item_id,
            sum(gc_sub_ledger_consumption.quantity_consumed) AS total_consumed
           FROM gc_sub_ledger_consumption
          GROUP BY gc_sub_ledger_consumption.office_id, gc_sub_ledger_consumption.consumed_by, gc_sub_ledger_consumption.item_id) cons ON (((issue.office_id = cons.office_id) AND ((issue.party)::text = (cons.consumed_by)::text) AND (issue.item_id = cons.item_id))));

SELECT id,
    authority,
    item_name,
    json_key AS mapped_category,
    unit,
    fixed_allowance
   FROM wage_items;

SELECT i.id AS item_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.authority,
    i.unit,
    o.letter_no,
    o.valid_from AS effective_date,
    ((o.rates ->> (i.json_key)::text))::numeric AS base_rate,
    i.fixed_allowance,
    (((o.rates ->> (i.json_key)::text))::numeric + COALESCE(i.fixed_allowance, (0)::numeric)) AS total_rate
   FROM (wage_items i
     JOIN wage_orders o ON ((i.authority = o.authority)))
  WHERE ((CURRENT_DATE >= o.valid_from) AND (CURRENT_DATE <= o.valid_to));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_wage_order(p_authority wage_authority, p_letter_no character varying, p_letter_date date, p_effective_from date, p_rates jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- 1. Update the previous latest order for this authority
    -- Set its valid_to to one day before the new effective date
    UPDATE wage_orders
    SET valid_to = p_effective_from - INTERVAL '1 day'
    WHERE authority = p_authority
      AND valid_to = '9999-12-31'; -- Only close the currently active one

    -- 2. Insert the new order
    INSERT INTO wage_orders (authority, letter_no, letter_date, valid_from, valid_to, rates)
    VALUES (p_authority, p_letter_no, p_letter_date, p_effective_from, '9999-12-31', p_rates);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_employee_wage_dashboard(p_agreement_id integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id integer, full_name character varying, designation character varying, first_wage_date date, last_wage_date date, pending_from date, pending_to date, current_balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.full_name,
        e.designation,
        (SELECT MIN(transaction_date) FROM wages_ledger WHERE employee_id = e.id AND cr_amount > 0) as first_wage,
        (SELECT MAX(transaction_date) FROM wages_ledger WHERE employee_id = e.id AND cr_amount > 0) as last_wage,

        -- Pending From: Day after last wage, or Joining Date if no wages yet
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT MAX(transaction_date) + INTERVAL '1 day' FROM wages_ledger WHERE employee_id = e.id AND cr_amount > 0),
            e.joining_date
        )::DATE as p_from,

        -- Pending To: Last day of previous month
        (DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE as p_to,

        -- Balance: Total CR - Total DR
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cr_amount) - SUM(dr_amount) FROM wages_ledger WHERE employee_id = e.id), 0) as balance

    FROM employees e
    WHERE e.agreement_id = p_agreement_id
    ORDER BY e.is_reliever ASC, e.designation ASC, e.full_name ASC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_wage_summary_report(p_agreement_id integer, p_due_from date, p_due_to date, p_drawn_on date)
 RETURNS TABLE(id integer, full_name character varying, due numeric, drawn numeric, balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
        SELECT
            e.id,
            e.full_name,
            -- Calculate Due amount for the specified period
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.cr_amount), 0)
             FROM wages_ledger wl
             WHERE wl.employee_id = e.id AND wl.transaction_date BETWEEN p_due_from AND p_due_to) as due_calc,

            -- Calculate Drawn amount up to the specified date
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.dr_amount), 0)
             FROM wages_ledger wl
             WHERE wl.employee_id = e.id AND wl.transaction_date <= p_drawn_on) as drawn_calc,

            -- Calculate Balance
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.cr_amount), 0) FROM wages_ledger wl WHERE wl.employee_id = e.id AND wl.transaction_date BETWEEN p_due_from AND p_due_to) -
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.dr_amount), 0) FROM wages_ledger wl WHERE wl.employee_id = e.id AND wl.transaction_date <= p_drawn_on) as balance_calc
        FROM employees e
        WHERE e.agreement_id = p_agreement_id
        GROUP BY e.id, e.full_name
        ORDER BY e.full_name;
END;
$function$
